purpose: Map which observable price-path and volatility-path states before a moving-average crossing are followed by directional continuation. The moving average is an event probe, not the definition of market state and not an optimization target.

data.market: all historical Binance USDT-margined perpetual contracts present in the accepted P0R2 panel; no crypto-only, stock-only, current-universe, market-cap, or hand-selected symbol filter
data.timeframe: complete UTC 1d bars aggregated from 96 audited closed 15m bars
data.gap_policy: features are calculated within the accepted per-symbol continuity block only
data.outcome_status: all dates in this study are exposed exploratory history; no result is clean OOS

events.prestate_information_cutoff: all market-state features end at t-1; trigger-day range, return, distance, and volume are stored separately and excluded from the primary prestate ML models
events.event_return: direction-signed trigger-close to future-close return; raw and pre-event ATR20 standardized
path_outcomes: first +2 ATR favorable barrier before -1 ATR adverse barrier within 10 or 20 sessions

prestate_axes.prior_move: direction-aligned return from t-61 through t-11, scaled by ATR20[t-1] as a percentage of price
prestate_axes.recent_move: direction-aligned return from t-11 through t-1 on the same scale
prestate_axes.shock_and_repair: largest adverse one-day shock, maximum adverse excursion, recovery from the adverse extreme, and distance from the favorable extreme over the prior 60 observations
prestate_axes.trend_lifecycle: 5/10/20/60 observation aligned returns, short-versus-long acceleration, and whether recent movement continues, pauses, pulls back, or reverses the older move
prestate_axes.path_shape: ER10/20/60, return-sign flip count, and current aligned location inside the prior 20/60 observation range
prestate_axes.consolidation: prior 5/10/20 range width relative to the prior 60 range and ATR10 relative to ATR60
prestate_axes.volatility: ATR20 as percent of price, its causal trailing-60 percentile, ATR change over 5/10/20 observations, and RV10/RV60

fixed_hypothesis_definitions.OPPOSITE_SHOCK_THEN_REPAIR: aligned maximum adverse excursion over 60 observations >= 5 ATR, aligned repair from the adverse extreme >= 1 ATR, and aligned recent-10 move >= 1 ATR
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.OPPOSITE_MOVE_THEN_BASE: aligned prior-50 move <= -3 ATR, absolute aligned recent-10 move <= 1 ATR, and prior 10/60 range ratio <= 0.35
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.ORDERLY_TREND_PULLBACK_RESUME: aligned prior-50 move >= 1 ATR, aligned recent-10 move <= -1 ATR, and ER60 >= 0.35
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.ORDERLY_TREND_CONTINUATION: aligned prior-50 and recent-10 moves >= 1 ATR, ER60 >= 0.35, and ER20 >= 0.35
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.LARGE_MOVE_THEN_SIDEWAYS_BREAK: absolute aligned prior-50 move >= 3 ATR, absolute aligned recent-10 move <= 1 ATR, and prior 10/60 range ratio <= 0.35
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.FAST_REVERSAL: aligned prior-50 move <= -1 ATR and aligned recent-10 move >= 3 ATR
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.EXTENDED_MOVE_CONTINUATION: aligned prior-50 move >= 3 ATR and aligned recent-10 move >= 3 ATR
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.EXTENDED_MOVE_EXHAUSTION: aligned prior-50 move >= 3 ATR and aligned recent-10 move <= -1 ATR
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.LOW_VOL_COMPRESSION: ATR-level causal percentile <= 20% and prior 10/60 range ratio <= 0.35
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.HIGH_VOL_CHOP: ATR-level causal percentile > 80%, ER20 < 0.25, and at least 8 return-sign flips in the prior 20 observations
fixed_hypothesis_definitions.LOW_EFFICIENCY_RECROSS: ER20 < 0.25 and at least 8 return-sign flips in the prior 20 observations

state_bucketing.volatility_level: causal own-history trailing-60 percentile: LOW <= 20%, NORMAL 20%-80%, HIGH > 80%
state_bucketing.volatility_path: causal own-history trailing-60 percentile of 10-observation ATR change: CONTRACTING <= 20%, STABLE 20%-80%, EXPANDING > 80%

machine_learning.role: diagnostic discovery of pre-event states only; no account, no trade-selection threshold, no strategy annualization
machine_learning.candidate_pool: all eligible MA crossing events, modeled separately by primary MA period and long/short direction
machine_learning.target: direction-signed 20-session trigger-close-to-future-close return divided by ATR20[t-1] as a percentage of trigger close
machine_learning.training: expanding history; training events must have complete 20-session outcomes before test start
reporting: Spearman rank correlation between prediction and realized continuation

event_statistics: symbol-and-date clustered t-stat and 95% confidence interval
required_outputs: event and signal frequency by MA, direction, year, month, and week

decision_boundary.next_strategy_requires: a small number of economically interpretable prestate relationships that keep the same ordering across MA7 and MA30, both directions or an explicitly justified asymmetry, multiple years, and broad symbol groups, followed by a newly frozen unseen confirmation period
